line-diff: Valid, minimal unified diffs, but not byte-identical to GNU diff -u; call the system diff when exact GNU output is required.
slugify: Transliterates Latin letters U+00C0-U+017F only; other scripts and emoji are dropped, so keep an id-based fallback for non-Latin titles.
rrule: Matches python-dateutil for FREQ DAILY to YEARLY with INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY and BYMONTH, in UTC; BYSETPOS, BYHOUR/BYMINUTE/BYSECOND, WKST and EXDATE are rejected.
json-patch: createPatch compares arrays by index: always correct, but not minimal when items are inserted or moved.
string-similarity: O(n*m) time; cap input length for user-supplied strings.
hashing: Not cryptographic: use HMAC or a password hash for anything an attacker can influence.
human-units: relativeTime and formatDuration produce English only.
base-encodings: base32 functions take the alphabet before the padding flag: pass padding by name where the language allows.
file-signature: A first check, not a malware scan: still re-encode or sandbox untrusted files, and note that text formats (SVG, HTML, CSV) are not detected.
vector-math: Brute force over every vector: fine for thousands of items; use an approximate index (HNSW, pgvector) beyond that.
text-chunking: Counts code points, not model tokens: size chunks with a margin or count tokens with your model's tokenizer.
glob-match: Paths use / only and matching is case-sensitive; normalize Windows paths and case before matching.
dotenv: Parses values only: no $(command) substitution, and expansion covers ${NAME} and ${NAME:-default}, not other shell forms.
query-string: Flat name/value pairs as browsers send them; nested forms such as a[b]=c are not expanded into objects.
mime-types: Looks at the file name only; check the bytes with file-signature before trusting an upload's type.
content-disposition: The sanitized filename is safe in a header, not as a storage path: store uploads under your own generated name.
cache-control: Parses directives and the freshness lifetime; full HTTP caching also needs Age, Expires, Vary and validators (see http-conditional).
punycode: Converts labels only: no IDNA2008/UTS 46 mapping, normalization or bidi checks; use the platform IDNA library before accepting user-typed domains.
base58: Bitcoin alphabet only; Base58Check here is the plain double-SHA-256 checksum, not address version or network validation.
dotted-path: A small path grammar (dots, [index], ["quoted"]), not JSONPath or JSON Pointer; use json-patch for RFC 6902/6901.
template-render: A logic-less Mustache subset: no partials, lambdas, delimiter changes or standalone-line whitespace rules; escaping is for HTML text and attribute values only.
ini-parse: INI has no single standard: this follows one documented dialect (no multi-line values or interpolation); check it against the files you must read.
pii-mask: Pattern-based masking for display and logs; it does not find every kind of personal data and is not a compliance control by itself.
html-escape: stripTags produces plain text and is not a sanitizer; use rich-text-sanitization before rendering user HTML.
